description: This header file declares the prototypes for functions related to the Ansc CoVer3 Object used in the Advanced Networking Service Container (ANSC). It provides function prototypes for object creation, removal, initialization, shutdown, and task management within the CoVer3 component.

methods.name: AnscCoVer3Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Ansc CoVer3 object with specified container and owner contexts.

methods.name: AnscCoVer3Remove
methods.description: Removes the specified Ansc CoVer3 object instance.

methods.name: AnscCoVer3EnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects for the Ansc CoVer3 component.

methods.name: AnscCoVer3Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the Ansc CoVer3 object.

methods.name: AnscCoVer3SpawnTask
methods.description: Spawns a new task with a specified entry point and context.

methods.name: AnscCoVer3SpawnTask2
methods.description: Spawns a new task with additional priority parameter.

methods.name: AnscCoVer3SpawnTask3
methods.description: Spawns a new task with priority and stack size parameters.

methods.name: AnscCoVer3EngineTask
methods.description: Executes the engine-related task for the CoVer3 component.

calls: ANSC_STATUS AnscCoVer3SpawnTask2(ANSC_HANDLE, void*, ANSC_HANDLE, char*, int)
ANSC_STATUS AnscCoVer3SpawnTask3(ANSC_HANDLE, void*, ANSC_HANDLE, char*, int, ULONG)
